2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connec- tion with Sidhwaliya PS Case No. 02 of 2023 dated- 07/01/2023 registered under Section 420 / 467 / 468 / 471 / 120(B) of the IPC.
3. As per the allegation the petitioner obtained appointment as Panchayat Teacher on the basis of forged mark sheet.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has not committed any offence in the manner alleged and at the time of his appointment he had produced mark-sheet issued by the Bihar School Examination Board.
The allegation of mismatch in the mark-sheet of BSEB is Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.35258 of 2023(2) dt.21-07-2023 not correct.
He submits that the petitioner was not given opportunity to place his defence on the point of falsity of the mark sheet.

The petitioner has already been terminated from service on this ground by letter dated: 25-01-2023 bearing no. 02 issued by the Panchayat Secretary-cum- Member Secretary, Panchayat Teacher Employment Unit, Gram Panchayat Raj, Khajuriya (Annexure - 2 to the bail application).

sentences.text: Panchayat Teacher were verified by the Vigilance Department and the mark sheet produced by the petitioner was found to be fake.

6. Regard being had to the submission made by the parties, taking into consideration the fact that the allega- tion against the petitioner is based upon documents for which custodial interrogation of the petitioner may not be necessary and the petitioner has been removed from service, as such, I am inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.35258 of 2023(2) dt.21-07-2023 7.

Let the petitioner, above named, be released on anticipatory bail in the event of arrest or surrender before the court below within a period of four weeks from today on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10000/- (rupees ten thou- sand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satis- faction of Smt. Babita Singh, Judicial Magistrate 1 st Class, Gopalganj in connection with Sidhwaliya PS Case No. 02 of 2023 subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Anil Kumar Sinha, J) praful/-
